name: Seraphim Doll
source:
As Eve, lead singer of band Fallen Seraph, you wear white lace and silver chains. You spread your arms like wings. on the stage you become something else. 
But when the lights fade and the makeup comes off, you're just Noa, a literature student who fades back into anonymity on the late night train home.

Tonight, someone is watching closer than the others. 

[From [url=https://worm3y.itch.io/seraphim-doll]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
作为Fallen Seraph乐队的主唱Eve，你穿着白色蕾丝和银链。你张开双臂，像翅膀一样。在舞台上你就变成了另外一个人。
但当灯光褪去、妆容褪去时，你就只是诺亚了，一名文学系的学生，在深夜回家的火车上又隐姓埋名。

今晚，有人比其他人看得更近。

[来自[url=https://worm3y.itch.io/seraphim-doll]itch.io[/url]]
